This API endpoint registers a customer’s intent to share content for an active campaign configured in the [Social Share Campaigns module](https://docs.antavo.com/docs/social-share-campaigns). Triggers the `share_intent_success` [event](https://developers.antavo.com/docs/internal-events#/share_intent_success) when a campaign match occurs.
Call this endpoint when a customer clicks a share button on a content page. Include the customer ID, target platform, and URL to be shared.
